Amazing Food, Wonderful Hospitality at Nhu Bau Family Restaurant Hoi An
Jun 2026 • Couples
We returned to Nhu Bau Family Restaurant during our stay in Hoi An, and once again it was one of the highlights of our trip. In fact, this was our third visit, which says a lot about how much we enjoy dining here. For us, Nhu Bau serves the best food in Hoi An, and it has become a must-visit destination every time we return.

From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed by Quynh and her family like old friends. Their warmth, friendliness, and genuine hospitality made us feel completely at home. It's clear that this family-owned restaurant is a true labour of love, with care and attention evident in every detail.

The food was outstanding. You can immediately tell that great care is taken in sourcing fresh local produce, and it shines through in every dish. Everything we ordered was beautifully prepared, full of flavour, and showcased the very best of the local ingredients. After three visits, we can honestly say the quality and consistency are exceptional.

What truly sets Nhu Bau Restaurant apart is the combination of exceptional food and heartfelt service. Every member of the family is attentive, caring, and genuinely passionate about ensuring guests have a memorable experience. It is rare to find a restaurant that excels in every aspect, but Nhu Bau Restaurant certainly does.

Located away from the busy centre of Hoi An, this hidden gem is well worth seeking out. The short trip off the beaten track rewards you with authentic food, outstanding hospitality, and a welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel like part of the family.

Highly recommended, and we cannot wait to return on our next trip to Vietnam. Thank you, Quynh, Anh, Phi, Mum & Dad, for another wonderful dining experience.

One word ..:. supercalifragilisticexpialidocious
Sep 2026 • Couples
Just wow !! .. and I mean just wow !! During a local stay in the area we visited by chance when having an Afternoon walk. during a couple of visits we selected numerous dishes and shared them, also asking Quynh to pick some for us. 
I’m a food lover and rarely want or find the need to shout about a place, but this real authentic family run restaurant is a remarkable find. Every dish .. and I mean EVERY DISH was cooked to perfection. We tried some dishes that were out of my norm ….where Quynh was able to show me dishes cooked so magnificently it’s changed my view on them for life. 
Over our stay we visited a few times and tried 18/19 dishes in all ,, and I can say not one of them let the side down. 
Quynh’s family were all amazing and super warm. I have to say this was the best place I ate in Vietnam by far. 
If you are staying near-bye I implore you to visit and dine here. You will not be disappointed and I feel you will also feel like you found a secret Vietnamese treasure, 
This is now my favourite restaurant in the world (I don’t say this lightly) for food and overall experience. It’s left me with great memories of the food and just how warm and caring a real Vietnamese family is. 
It’s going to be very hard for any place or chef to beat this now.

The best restaurant in Hoi An with the best people in Hoi An!
Jul 2026 • Couples
Good time, finish the review, please!
For starters, I rarely write reviews, but this restaurant rightfully deserves an honest review. My wife and I stayed in a villa nearby and on the first night in Hoi An we went to this restaurant we found from reviews! Next, I'm going to go over the points we liked:
1 - Food and drink. We tried 2 types of fried rice, seafood and pineapple, spring rolls, squid, shrimp, fish and mango and banana cocktails, and we were absolutely thrilled with the food and drink! These were probably the most delicious seafood we've tasted in eight cities!
2 - People. The restaurant itself is owned by very nice and kind people who can be very interesting to talk to in English and who are ready to help you in a difficult situation. And that's the situation we had - the wife got sick because of the overheating and needed something simple to eat. I went to this restaurant, and when I heard the situation, the owner offered to make my wife rice porridge (it wasn't on the menu) completely free! Honestly, I was really amazed by it and still really thank her for it, my wife was relieved quickly! Porridge like other food that evening I took out, the good is safe to pick up food, which is not possible in every local restaurant!
3 - Prices. Very pleasant prices, dinner for two of us costs 250 - 300 thousand dong with drinks, which for us is a very good price, especially after Da Nang and the center of Hoi An!
4 - Atmosphere. The restaurant is located on the riverbank with very beautiful views in the evenings, and a table on the street with garlands around it will make the evening in this restaurant special and memorable for life! There's also muffled, pleasant music and there are sounds of nature everywhere, which we really enjoyed!
In conclusion, I would like to say that you should definitely come to this restaurant for at least 1 evening, and no matter what part of Hoi An you are in, it will be worth it, I guarantee you that! This restaurant deserves much more popularity than it currently has!!! When we return to Vietnam we will definitely visit this wonderful place again!!
